Recent graduate (M.Ent.) from Carnegie Mellon University with 7+ years of professional experience in film and television before transitioning into human-computer interaction and immersive media research. My work investigates how AI, implicit interaction, and computational systems can expand cinematic language and reshape audience engagement in XR experiences. I combine expertise in narrative design, creative production, and user-centered research to develop interactive storytelling systems informed by HCI, machine learning, and cognitive science.

Research Interests

  • Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
  • XR & Immersive Storytelling
  • Computational Narrative
  • AI-assisted Creative Systems
  • Implicit Interaction
  • Neurocinematics
  • Human-AI Collaboration
